# thundercompute_instance (Resource)

Manages a Thunder Compute GPU instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "thundercompute_instance" "training" {
  gpu_type     = "h100"
  template     = "base"
  cpu_cores    = 4
  disk_size_gb = 200
  num_gpus     = 1
  http_ports   = [8888]
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh -p ${thundercompute_instance.training.port} ubuntu@${thundercompute_instance.training.ip}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cpu_cores` (Number) Number of vCPU cores.
- `disk_size_gb` (Number) Disk size in GB. Valid range varies by GPU type; see the thundercompute_gpu_specs data source.
- `gpu_type` (String) GPU type (for example a6000, a100xl, l40, l40s, or h100). API requests are normalized to the public lowercase identifier; a100 is accepted as an alias for a100xl while configured spelling is preserved in state.
- `num_gpus` (Number) Number of GPUs.
- `template` (String) OS template or snapshot name. Changing this forces recreation.

### Optional

- `http_ports` (Set of Number) Set of HTTP ports to expose publicly via thundercompute.net. Omitted or null adopts template, snapshot, or server defaults; an explicit empty set reconciles to no HTTP ports; a non-empty set reconciles exactly.
- `public_key` (String) SSH public key to inject at creation time. Prefer a user-supplied key so Terraform does not need to retain an auto-generated private key in state.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Instance creation timestamp.
- `generated_key` (String, Sensitive) Auto-generated SSH private key, populated on creation when no public_key was provided. Sensitive values remain stored in Terraform state; use encrypted remote state with restricted access.
- `id` (String) Instance UUID (Terraform resource ID).
- `identifier` (Number) Internal numeric instance index used by the API. This value may change when instances are created or deleted and should not be relied upon externally.
- `ip` (String) Instance IP address.
- `memory` (String) Allocated memory.
- `name` (String) Instance display name.
- `port` (Number) SSH port.
- `ssh_public_keys` (List of String) SSH public keys authorized on this instance.
- `status` (String) Current instance status.

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import thundercompute_instance.example <instance-uuid>
```
